lines.zh: 我拖着巨大的壳走，很慢。
lines.en: I drag my huge shell along, slowly.

lines.zh: 壳有三格宽，我占两条道。
lines.en: My shell is three blocks wide. I take two lanes.
My shell grinds on the ground as I walk.

lines.zh: 四条腿短，撑不起这个重量。
lines.en: Four short legs can't carry this weight well.
I work my way toward the water.
A wide furrow is left on the sand.
I go around the reef so I don't wedge in.

lines.zh: 我头上有角，撞到什么都疼。
lines.en: I have a horn. Hitting anything hurts.
Weeds have grown on my shell.
My shell grinds the sand with a dull hiss.

lines.zh: 我朝有海水声音的地方走。
lines.en: I head toward the sound of the sea.
Eight legs, and really only four.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙上，壳挡住了太阳。
lines.en: I lie on the sand and my shell blocks the sun.
Through my shell seams I hear the wave pulling back.
There's water sound inside the shell.

lines.zh: 我用角在沙上划了一道。
lines.en: I scrape a line in the sand with my horn.

lines.zh: 沙下的水在往我这边渗。
lines.en: Water seeps toward me under the sand.

lines.zh: 潮水来的时候，我就能走了。
lines.en: When it comes I can move easily.

lines.zh: 海草从我的壳缝里长出来。
lines.en: Seaweed grows out of the seams in my shell.
I keep still and it stays.
The tide goes out and I settle again.

lines.zh: 我从壳缝里喷出一口咸气。
lines.en: I puff salt breath from the shell's seam.
The weeds on my shell sway.
This body of mine is heavy.
There's an advantage to heavy.
Whatever hits me backs off first.
You're shorter than my shell.
I raise my head and point my horn at you.
It's my only weapon.
This shell of mine doesn't turn fast.
So don't go around behind.
You're at my flank.
I come round a little at a time.

lines.zh: 你绕到壳后面，我转不动。
lines.en: You go behind my shell, and I cannot turn.
This is my beach. I know it.
You're standing on my path.
My horn lowers toward you.
You've made way.
This shell slows my walk.
I ought to thank you.
I'm going into the water.
It's lighter there.
There's a new white line on my shell.
A white line on the shell. It doesn't hurt.
That rocked me.
Another white scar joins the ones on my shell.
I poke my head out a little.
I poke my head out to see who.
The shellmon's shell got dented.
I rub it off on the sand.
Four legs can still lift me.
Then there's nothing wrong.
That smells of seafood.
The shell is heavy; I shift very slowly.
That step took a long time.
Just set it down.

lines.zh: 你把鱼放在浪能打到的地方。
lines.en: Leave the fish where the surf can reach it.
My shell is too heavy. I can't lower my head.
You put it by my mouth.
Now I can reach it.
Swallowed whole — didn't even spit the shell.
A warmth spreads inside my shell.
Have you got more?
I keep my mouth open for the next.
You hit the shell and bounce off.

lines.zh: 你撞的地方，壳上有层盐。
lines.en: Where you hit, my shell is crusted with salt.
You come close and the shell rim shoves you off.
Turning the shell is heavy work.
The shell shoved you aside a little.
I can't make the turn.
The shell can't turn.

lines.zh: 这一片沙子被我压平了。
lines.en: I've flattened this patch of sand.
Stand further off.
My shell scrapes the sand as it pushes through.
There are other shells in the sea.
Its shell is one growth ring older than mine.
And when we do, we don't speak.
We just look at each other's shells.

lines.zh: 壳上有几道痕，就是活了多少年。
lines.en: The marks on the shell count the years.
Mine has a lot.
I've lost count.
They don't know either.

lines.zh: 壳上的痕迹，谁也说不清。
lines.en: No one can read the marks on a shell.
We all crawl forward.
I lower my head and can't reach.
I hook it over with my horn.
I've always used that trick.
My horn has hooked it over.
I open my mouth and swallow.
There's a gurgle inside the shell.
Too heavy. I sat down.
Sand got in my mouth.
I spit twice and try again.
Slower this time. It worked.
A shadow moves past the surf line.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，角朝那个方向。
lines.en: I raise my head, horn that way.
Only now do I start to shift.
Slower than the tide.
It has not left, so I keep shifting forward.
One step. Another.

lines.zh: 我每挪一步，沙就陷一指。
lines.en: Every step I take sinks the sand a finger deep.
It tilts its head at the sand.
It turns and looks this way.
I halt on the sand ridge.

lines.zh: 我冲不过去，只能走过去。
lines.en: I can't charge. I can only walk over.
That will do well enough.
I shift toward it.
It goes back two steps, I shift one.
So I change direction.
I go around toward where it's retreating.
I go round very slowly indeed.

lines.zh: 它跑起来，我照样挪过去。
lines.en: It runs, and I keep shifting toward it all the same.
The sand is soft. It can't run fast.
Neither can I.
But I don't tire at all.
It steps into soft sand and its pace sags.
It's panting hard.
I raise my head. It's right there.
My horn drives forward.

lines.zh: 这一下，把它顶出去很远。
lines.en: That sends it a long way.
This big shell hurts when it hits.
This one hits the sand.
It's gone behind me.
I can't turn.
It hits my shell.
The shell hasn't a mark.

lines.zh: 转过来的时候，它又绕了。
lines.en: By the time I turn it's gone round again.
I don't give chase.
I head for the water.
In the water I can turn.
I'm washed up out of the surf.
My shell lands first and digs a crater.
I lie in the crater a long while.
Then I try to stand.
I'm finally up.

lines.zh: 这里是一片沙滩，海在那边。
lines.en: This is a beach. The sea is over there.
I walk toward it, very slowly.
There's sand from elsewhere on my shell.
I don't know these waters.
Water is water.

lines.zh: 浪把我推到沙上，我睁眼。
lines.en: A wave shoves me onto the sand and I open my eyes.
I pay it no mind. I need the water first.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，里面很闷。
lines.en: Fire heats the shell and it's stifling inside.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上滚下来，壳磕响了。
lines.en: I roll off the reef and my shell clangs.

lines.zh: 我沉到太深，壳被压得响。
lines.en: I sink too deep and my shell creaks under the pressure.

lines.zh: 炸响把壳掀翻，我翻了身。
lines.en: The blast flips the shell and I'm on my back.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在壳上，进不去。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in the shell and goes no further.

lines.zh: 一道光绕着壳转，我里面发冷。
lines.en: A light circles the shell and I go cold inside.
There's nothing on this beach.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的壳上，我全身都震了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell and my whole body shakes.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有浪声，我发慌。
lines.en: No surf in the void, and it frightens me.
